title: Rig Relay Repository Readiness v1
description: Compact Y0 repository readiness projection. Provides a lightweight status snapshot consumed by Gridline and dashboard surfaces to determine whether a repository is ready for agent work.

repository_root.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

lifecycle_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the repository context pipeline.

context_released.description: True when a context release has been emitted for this repository.

workspace_eligible.description: True when the workspace eligibility assessment reports eligible.

degraded.description: True when one or more lifecycle stages failed or produced degraded results.

blocker_count.description: Number of active blockers preventing lifecycle advancement.

context_confidence.description: Estimated confidence in the context release (0.0 to 1.0).

last_released_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent context release, or null if never released.

release_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the current context release, or null if never released.

projection_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of this projection.
